messages:
maria-sales: Kicking off a quick sync — we need a concise POC runbook for the Prospero deal. Main asks: success criteria, golden prompt set, scoring rubric, timeline, and any enterprise blockers (pricing/secu).
ethan-de: Thanks — high level: 3 flows (support triage, knowledge search, billing QA). Each flow needs 20 goldens + 30 regression cases.
priya-se: Can we trim to 15 goldens per flow? Customer wants faster turnaround, and we can expand later.
maria-sales: @priya-se probably fine if we prioritize high-value intents. Will the eval harness support weighted scoring?
nate-eng: Yes — harness supports per-case weights and a composite score. Suggested schema: correctness (50), safety/compliance (30), latency/format (20).
sara-ps: Quick note on scoring: for triage we allow partial credit for 'next-best-action' suggestions. We'll add an example in the golden set.
maria-sales: Pricing question from procurement: if we need Dedicated GPUs during trial window, what's the delta vs hosted? ballpark numbers pls.
ethan-de: Short answer: hosted usage + 20% markup for burst; Dedicated reserved capacity add-on is monthly — for a 2-week trial we recommend hosted with reserved burst (est ~ $1.2k-$2.5k depending on token volume). I can surface an itemized estimate.
priya-se: Security: customer asked for iso27001 evidence + answers to 6 SSO/KMS questions. @sec-bot can you drop the checklist link?
sec-bot: Here: https://intra.redwood/security/presales-checklist — includes template answers. For POC, recommend enabling VPC egress controls and masking logs for any PHI.
maria-sales: Great. Ops blockers: legal asked about data retention during trial. We should propose 30-day retention and option to purge on request.
sara-ps: Agree. Also add a regression gate: if composite score drops >5 points vs baseline, auto rollback to stable model variant.
nate-eng: Implementation detail for harness: use deterministic seeds for sampling, store raw model outputs + evaluation metadata, and surface diffs in the console. Example command to run harness locally:
```
python eval_harness/run.py --cases=golden_triage.json --weights='{"correct":0.5,"safety":0.3,"format":0.2}' --seed=42
```
ethan-de: For acceptance, final criteria proposal: 1) composite >= 85 for each flow, 2) avg latency < 300ms 95p, 3) no critical security flags in static checks.
priya-se: Timeline: week 0 - alignment & golden set draft; week 1 - harness infra + first run; week 2 - tuning & regression runs; week 3 - joint demo + sign-off. Can compress to 2 weeks if customer provides 90% of golden prompts up front.
maria-sales: Action items: @ethan produce cost estimate by EOD; @priya assemble first-pass goldens (15 per flow) by tomorrow noon; @nate provide harness runbook + quickstart snippet; @sara draft acceptance gates into Confluence.
ethan-de: On it. I'll include burst vs dedicated cost scenarios.
priya-se: Uploading goldens now -> https://files.redwood/presales/prospero/goldens_v1.json :thumbsup:
maria-sales: Thanks team. If legal/security/finance need to join, loop them in. We'll update the customer-facing POC runbook after we have the harness results.
sara-ps: I'll draft the sign-off checklist and include rollback playbook.
sec-bot: Reminder: run automated SCA and vuln scan against any infra changes before trial start.
maria-sales: Closing loop — we'll reconvene after first harness run. Thanks all.
